description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Many materia medica. Including some interesting commodities, e.g. violet oil, sandalwood, polypodium, costus, myrobalan, litharge,Many materia medica. Including some interesting commodities, e.g. violet oil, sandalwood, polypodium, costus, myrobalan, litharge, dragon's blood, kohl applicators (makāḥil), "needles" (ibar), something (arḍ?) Yamānī, and mummy (mūmiyāʾ).
